statement: There are n courses, numbered 0 to n − 1. You are given graph, made of the vertex count n and a list of edges [a, b], each meaning course a must be finished before course b can be taken.
Return true if it is possible to finish all n courses, and false otherwise. It is impossible exactly when the prerequisites form a cycle.

examples.explanation: The courses can be taken in the order 0, 1, 2, 3, which respects every prerequisite.
Each course waits on another in the loop 0 → 1 → 2 → 0, so none of them can be started.
